text: Patient presents with cough and fever. Temperature 38.5°C. No sore throat noted. Patient denies nausea. Possible infection suspected.
Patient returns for follow-up. Cough persists but fever has resolved. No nausea. Patient reports fatigue since last Monday.
Patient reports cough has improved significantly. No fever. Fatigue is better. No longer has shortness of breath.
Patient complains of headache and dizziness. No fever. No chest pain. Sore throat present.
Headache has resolved. Dizziness persists. Possible vertigo. Denies cough. No fever Monday; fever started Wednesday. Patient now reports chest pain started today.
Dizziness subsided. No chest pain reported. Sore throat cleared. No rash.
Patient has fever and rash on arms. Denies cough. No shortness of breath. Fatigue present.
Fever present again. Rash has resolved. No fatigue. Patient may have infection.
No fever. No rash. Fatigue has returned. No cough. No nausea.
Patient with shortness of breath and chest pain. Possible pneumonia. No fever. No cough.
Shortness of breath improved. Chest pain present. No fever. No cough. No nausea.
Chest pain has resolved. No shortness of breath. Patient reports headache started two days ago.
Patient denies all symptoms. No fever, no cough, no nausea, no headache.
Patient presents with sudden onset fever and cough. Denies rash. No chest pain.
Fever and cough persist. No improvement. Patient also reports nausea started yesterday.
